description:
Today the everyday popup shows almost none of the 73 motion exhibits: features are on only through `--motion` or VOXTYPE_OSD_VO_MOTION, and the daemon passes neither. This bead adds per-look default motion sets, so each look runs the effects the redesign gave it.

- Look::on (voxtype_osd_vo.rs) also answers true for the look's defaults, unless motion is set to `none`.

Files: src/bin/osd_vo/defaults.rs (new), src/bin/voxtype_osd_vo.rs, src/osd/config.rs, docs/CONFIGURATION.md.

Given the swiss look and no motion config, when a dictation runs, then pause-marks, pitch-baseline, audio-ruler and fold-under are on.
Given `[osd] motion = "none"`, when a dictation runs, then no default extras are on.
Given `--motion onset-ink`, then only onset-ink is on (the flag replaces the set).
